notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
*Fix Graphical Glitch for "Guitarj" in How to play
*Memory Optimization
*Updated Defense Gun having multiple spawn Glitch
*Added Initial 10 Cash
*Changed Hit Remaining to 10 instead of 5
*No Longer Die when Cash is less than 1
*Sending Sukaan Home Now Gives 10 OMR
*Increased Defense gun Duration to 30 Seconds
